title: Packed arrays are passed by reference

blocks.text:
The Pool*Array types have been renamed to Packed*Array, and instead of
being passed by value, they are now passed by reference. Code that mutated
a copy of a Pool*Array in Godot 3 will now mutate the original Packed*Array
in Godot 4 — a silent behavioral change the 3-to-4 converter's rename does
not warn about.
